senses.gloss:
खिद r. 4th and 7th cls. (खिद्यते and खिंते) To be distressed, to suffer pain
or misery. (औ, प) औखिदप् r. 6th cl. (खिन्दति) To afflict or distress.

खिदिर m. (-रः) The moon.
 2. An ascetic, a penitent, 3. A pauper, E.
खिद् to suffer pain, किरच् Uṇādi aff.

खिद्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Suffering pain or distress.
 E. खिद्, with शानच्
aff.

खिद्र m. (-द्रः)
 1. Disease, sickness.
 2. A pauper, a poor man
 E. खिद् to be
in pain, रक् Uṇādi aff.
